title: Recover IBC light client for Injective (07-tendermint-0)
summary: This proposal updates the expired IBC light client `07-tendermint-0` for counterparty chain `injective-1` with the state of the substitute client `07-tendermint-8`. This revives transfer/channel-0 to Injective transfer/channel-436, which holds ~35,417 XRP in escrow.
